script:
void generateGroupSummary(date target_date)
{
                 	// Call compute functions
                 	result = estate_manager.planning.sendGroupedMonthlyCollections(target_date);
                 	// Validate result (main)
                 	if(result == null || result.get("ok") != true)
                 	{
                 		info "Compute failed (estate_manager): " + ifnull(result.get("msg"),"unknown error");
                 		return;
                 	}
                 	period_start = result.get("period_start");
                 	// Clear ONLY this month to avoid duplicates
                 	delete from Group_Summary[Period == period_start && Group == "1A" || Group == "1B" || Group == "1C" || Group == "1D" || Group == "1E" || Group == "2A" || Group == "3" || Group == "3A" || Group == "3B" || Group == "3C" || Group == "3D" || Group == "3E" || Group == "3F" || Group == "4" || Group == "1F"];
                 	// Insert groups from result
                 	insert into Group_Summary
                 	[
                 		Group="1A"
                 		Received=result.get("received1A")
                 		Period=period_start
                 		Added_User=zoho.loginuser
                 	]
                 	insert into Group_Summary
                 	[
                 		Group="1B"
                 		Received=result.get("received1B")
                 		Period=period_start
                 		Added_User=zoho.loginuser
                 	]
                 	insert into Group_Summary
                 	[
                 		Group="1C"
                 		Received=result.get("received1C")
                 		Period=period_start
                 		Added_User=zoho.loginuser
                 	]
                 	insert into Group_Summary
                 	[
                 		Group="1D"
                 		Received=result.get("received1D")
                 		Period=period_start
                 		Added_User=zoho.loginuser
                 	]
                 	insert into Group_Summary
                 	[
                 		Group="1E"
                 		Received=result.get("received1E")
                 		Period=period_start
                 		Added_User=zoho.loginuser
                 	]
                 	insert into Group_Summary
                 	[
                 		Group="1F"
                 		Received=result.get("received1F")
                 		Period=period_start
                 		Added_User=zoho.loginuser
                 	]
                 	insert into Group_Summary
                 	[
                 		Group="2A"
                 		Received=result.get("received2A")
                 		Period=period_start
                 		Added_User=zoho.loginuser
                 	]
                 	insert into Group_Summary
                 	[
                 		Group="3"
                 		Received=result.get("received3")
                 		Period=period_start
                 		Added_User=zoho.loginuser
                 	]
                 	insert into Group_Summary
                 	[
                 		Group="3A"
                 		Received=result.get("received3A")
                 		Period=period_start
                 		Added_User=zoho.loginuser
                 	]
                 	insert into Group_Summary
                 	[
                 		Group="3B"
                 		Received=result.get("received3B")
                 		Period=period_start
                 		Added_User=zoho.loginuser
                 	]
                 	insert into Group_Summary
                 	[
                 		Group="3C"
                 		Received=result.get("received3C")
                 		Period=period_start
                 		Added_User=zoho.loginuser
                 	]
                 	insert into Group_Summary
                 	[
                 		Group="3D"
                 		Received=result.get("received3D")
                 		Period=period_start
                 		Added_User=zoho.loginuser
                 	]
                 	insert into Group_Summary
                 	[
                 		Group="3F"
                 		Received=result.get("received3F")
                 		Period=period_start
                 		Added_User=zoho.loginuser
                 	]
                 	insert into Group_Summary
                 	[
                 		Group="4"
                 		Received=result.get("received3F")
                 		Period=period_start
                 		Added_User=zoho.loginuser
                 	]
                 }
